column1: # Tuned for an API behind Application Gateway. Each IGNORE has a reason; an
# unexplained IGNORE should fail code review.

column3: Incomplete cache-control - the API is no-store by default via headers middleware
Information disclosure in suspicious comments - matches on ERP domain words
HSTS - set by App Gateway rewrite rule, absent when testing via port-forward
Permissions-Policy - set by the API middleware
Timestamp disclosure - ERP responses legitimately contain order dates
Modern web application detection - informational only
Absence of anti-CSRF tokens - the BFF is token-based, not cookie-based
Private IP disclosure - would leak the pod CIDR to the internet
